seedPackets.title: Rain Gauge Railway Sequence Packet
seedPackets.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free printable packet for turning three yard or window view details into a clear beginning, middle, and ending.
seedPackets.adultSetup: Print one paper story seed packet, fold it on the table, choose a yard, garden view, porch view, or window view, and keep the activity eyes-and-ears only.
seedPackets.kidDirection: Look, listen, point to three broad clues, sketch them in order, and imagine each one as a tiny railway signal.
seedPackets.packetLabelPrompt: My paper railway seed packet is labeled ____________________ because one safe clue looks like a tiny train signal.
seedPackets.detailSeedsPrompt: Sketch three story seeds: first clue ____________________, next clue ____________________, final clue ____________________.
seedPackets.storySeedPrompt: A careful railway helper notices the gauge card change when ____________________.
seedPackets.sproutSentencePath: First ____________________; next ____________________; finally ____________________, so the helper writes one calm story note.
seedPackets.revisionNudge: Revise by adding one sound, color, or order word to the middle step: ____________________.
seedPackets.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: point to the three clues, sketch one, and write only the final word: ____________________.
seedPackets.takeHomeLine: Take-home seed: From a table or window view, imagine one tiny railway line and write ____________________.

seedPackets.title: Seed Library Map Room Object Packet
seedPackets.useCase: Adult-led, offline printable packet for making one table, porch view, or garden view detail become the key object in a map-room story.
seedPackets.adultSetup: Print one paper story seed packet, place it on the table, and remind the writer that this is pretend packet work, not a gardening activity.
seedPackets.kidDirection: Look at one broad detail, point to it, sketch a pretend label, and imagine why the Seed Library Map Room needs that object.
seedPackets.packetLabelPrompt: This paper seed packet belongs in the drawer labeled ____________________.
seedPackets.storySeedPrompt: The map room opens a folded card and finds ____________________ inside.
seedPackets.sproutSentencePath: The object looks like ____________________, but it acts like ____________________, so the keeper decides ____________________.
seedPackets.revisionNudge: Revise by adding one exact size, color, or placement detail to the object: ____________________.
seedPackets.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: sketch the object first, then write its quiet label here: ____________________.
seedPackets.takeHomeLine: Take-home seed: At a table, choose one ordinary object and turn it into a map-room clue: ____________________.

seedPackets.title: Moss Message Observatory Sensory Packet
seedPackets.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free printable packet for turning a garden view, park edge, or window view into safe sensory description.
seedPackets.adultSetup: Print one paper story seed packet, choose a calm garden view, park edge, or window view, and keep the writing based on looking, listening, and imagining.
seedPackets.kidDirection: Look for a color, listen for a quiet sound, point to a pattern, sketch it, and imagine it as an observatory message.
seedPackets.packetLabelPrompt: The observatory packet is labeled with this quiet message: ____________________.
seedPackets.detailSeedsPrompt: Sensory seeds I can safely notice: color ____________________, pattern ____________________, sound ____________________.
seedPackets.storySeedPrompt: A paper observatory note repeats when ____________________ appears in the view.
seedPackets.sproutSentencePath: The observer sees ____________________, listens for ____________________, and imagines the message means ____________________.
seedPackets.revisionNudge: Revise one plain description by adding a sharper sensory word: ____________________.
seedPackets.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: point silently to one pattern, sketch it, and write the message word: ____________________.
seedPackets.takeHomeLine: Take-home seed: From a window view, turn one color or sound into an observatory clue: ____________________.

seedPackets.title: Pantry Measurement Setting Packet
seedPackets.useCase: Adult-led, offline printable packet for building a setting from shape, count, and table details.
seedPackets.adultSetup: Print one paper story seed packet, use a table, porch view, shelf view, or window view, and keep it as paper imagination only.
seedPackets.kidDirection: Look at one shape, count one small group, point to one ordinary object, sketch the scene, and imagine a pantry mystery.
seedPackets.packetLabelPrompt: My paper pantry packet is labeled ____________________.
seedPackets.detailSeedsPrompt: Setting seeds: shape ____________________, counted group ____________________, ordinary object ____________________.
seedPackets.storySeedPrompt: The pantry mystery begins when the paper label beside ____________________ changes to ____________________.
seedPackets.sproutSentencePath: In the pantry scene, ____________________ sits near ____________________, while ____________________ makes the setting feel new.
seedPackets.revisionNudge: Revise by adding one where-detail so the reader can picture the shelf or table: ____________________.
seedPackets.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: sketch the shape first, then write one setting word: ____________________.
seedPackets.takeHomeLine: Take-home seed: At a table, turn one shape or counted detail into a setting sentence: ____________________.

seedPackets.title: Compass Craft Academy Revision Packet
seedPackets.useCase: Adult-led, screen-free printable packet for older writers who need to revise vague movement into clearer story direction.
seedPackets.adultSetup: Print one paper story seed packet, set it on the table, choose a yard, porch view, garden view, window view, or park edge, and invite pointing and sketching only.
seedPackets.kidDirection: Look for one direction clue, point to it, sketch a simple map mark, imagine a clearer scene, and revise one plain sentence.
seedPackets.packetLabelPrompt: Compass Craft packet label: this revision seed points toward ____________________.
seedPackets.detailSeedsPrompt: Revision seeds: vague line ____________________, clearer direction ____________________, stronger choice ____________________.
seedPackets.storySeedPrompt: A mapmaker at the academy fixes a confusing scene by noticing ____________________.
seedPackets.sproutSentencePath: Plain sentence: The helper went there. Revised sentence: The helper moved toward ____________________ because ____________________.
seedPackets.revisionNudge: Replace a vague word with a precise direction, distance, or mood word: ____________________.
seedPackets.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: revise one sentence silently and underline the clearer clue: ____________________.
seedPackets.takeHomeLine: Take-home seed: Use the revised clue as the turning point in a compass-academy scene: ____________________.
